item.title: A calmer way to read the web
item.author: mara@example.com (Mara Bell)
item.description:
The web is still at its best when it feels like a library: quiet, durable, and yours to explore.

Keep the useful parts close

rxs saves downloaded articles in a local SQLite database, so a train tunnel or flaky connection never interrupts your reading list.

  • Move quickly with familiar keyboard shortcuts.
  • Search titles and downloaded article text.
  • Star useful stories and return to them later.

Feeds stay simple, portable, and available offline. Read more about local-first software.
